E-Sys MAX 5.4.3 (beta)

New
- Go back safely: if an update is ever taken back, E-Sys MAX tells you once and offers the last safe version with one click. Nothing changes without your yes.
- Beta badge: click it to go back to the normal version at any time.

Improved
- Updates: the update helper is faster and more reliable.
- Setup check: on a PC shared by several Windows accounts, it tells you when the EDIABAS folder can be changed by another account.
- Many small safety and stability fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
